name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static document roots, security headers, Fail2ban, firewall and SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Provisions Memcached and Redis cache services, including Redis configuration, logging, startup, and password authentication.
